description: SO(7) BMN Q-cohomology on SU(3)_R highest-weight vectors, complete scan at j = 20 (all 14 columns q1>=q2>=q3 with q1+q2+q3 = 10, all 2J), fortuity.hwcoh.run_sectors format. Non-graviton classes: exactly one, (4,3,3) [1,0] at 2J=2 (the SU(1|3) descendant of the j=18 class of R-005).
code: code/fortuity/hwcoh (group='SO_odd', ENGINE=par, HW_CACHE shared between SO(7) and G2)
conventions: D-006 BMN conventions; graviton generators up to n = 8 (GEN_NMAX=8); dims from fortuity.hwcoh.dims.partition_dims_nf(3, 26, group='SO_odd').
command: scripts/bmn/so-usp-g2-scans/runs/run_j20.sh (ENGINE=par GROUP=SO_odd GEN_NMAX=8 python -m fortuity.hwcoh.run_sectors 3 dims.pkl out.jsonl <14 columns>)
checked: Per-sector self-check rank = m (all sectors); per column, the Euler characteristic sum_2J (-1)^2J h equals the SU(3)_R multiplicity in the exact BMN index (fortuity.bmn.groupindex) in all 14 columns. Single seed.
